purpose: Simplify the single mixed second-connection insertion Gamma_AB in the rough one-form Laplacian on the locked ambient linear strain path.

ambient_simplification.general_constant_symmetric_bilinear: For b_L(Y,Z)=<Y,LZ> on unit S3, C_L(X,Y,Z)=-2<X,Y><Z,Lx>.
ambient_simplification.first_connection_inputs: C_A=-4 g ⊗ a_A, C_B=-4 g ⊗ a_B, with a_A=(Ax)^T and a_B=(Bx)^T.
ambient_simplification.inverse_metric_variations: m_A=-h_A^sharp=-2 A_T and m_B=-2 B_T on tangent vectors, in the background metric.
ambient_simplification.w_AB: w_AB = -ell_AB + 4 A_T a_B + 4 B_T a_A, where ell_AB=((AB+BA)x)^T.

rough_laplacian_single_slot.starting_slot: -g^{ij}[ -nabla_i(Gamma_AB^d_jc alpha_d) - Gamma_AB^d_ij nabla_d alpha_c - Gamma_AB^d_ic nabla_j alpha_d ]
rough_laplacian_single_slot.after_Gamma_gw_substitution: L_single_GammaAB(alpha)_c = nabla_c(w_AB^d alpha_d) + 3 w_AB^d nabla_d alpha_c + w_AB^d nabla_c alpha_d
rough_laplacian_single_slot.expanded: L_single_GammaAB(alpha)_c = (nabla_c w_AB^d) alpha_d + 2 w_AB^d nabla_c alpha_d + 3 w_AB^d nabla_d alpha_c
rough_laplacian_single_slot.scope_warning: This is only the single Gamma_AB insertion slot in the connection part. It excludes Gamma_A Gamma_B products and inverse-metric/first-connection cross terms.
